2023-4289-4359-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1355-1719.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-1719.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-1719.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-1719.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2506-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-3249-4314-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4314-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2558-7422-8095--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-7422-8095--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

757-2348-5087-5101.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-2348-5087-5101.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Merfolk Skydiver to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

277-851-3129-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1809-1987-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1809-1987-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

650-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

914-3036-7296.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-7296.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

4294-5220-6797.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

944-2191-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2099-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2099-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2499-2573-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-2573-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-2573-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

620-1976-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-1976-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

681-4826-5226-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4826-5226-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

1305-4785-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4476-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4476-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Answered Prayers indestructible.
3490-4476-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

542-4872-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
542-4872-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
542-4872-6333.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

465-719-1251-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student // Tamiyo, Seasoned Scholar

708-4050-4753-6223.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator on the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-4050-4753-6223.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat.

1283-2825-3525-4923.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2825-3525-4923.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cabal Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, this combo nets infinite mana.

240-2438-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Egg or a creature with changeling.
240-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a nontoken Egg or a nontoken creature with changeling.
When the creature dies, Atla Palani and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing the creature from the top of your library and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

428-3908-4767-4983.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Silverclad Ferocidons.
428-3908-4767-4983.description:
Give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Silverclad Ferocidons, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Silverclad Ferocidons, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Silverclad Ferocidons, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Silverclad Ferocidons trigger.
Resolve the Silverclad Ferocidons trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a permanent.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Silverclad Ferocidons, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Silverclad Ferocidons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

112-565-914.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
112-565-914.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve Clockspinning, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 1 to create infinite token copies of them.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2440-3705-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Goblin.
392-2440-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1479-1671-2783.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-2783.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
